theme_strategy: Hybrid Fullstack - Public Site (Dark Theme) & Admin Back-Office (Light Theme)
archetype: Public: Archetype 5 (Luxury, Cinematic) / Admin: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast, Data-First)

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 MAX text-6xl (clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem)) tracking-tighter leading-none. Subtitles/Labels MUST be uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs or text-sm. Do not center everything; use left-alignment for long text and asymmetric grids.

hero_immersive.description: Candlelit dining scene under verdant plants for the immersive hero section

concept_plating.description: Gourmet dish being plated in dark moody kitchen

gala_event.description: Elegant banquet table set in a moody restaurant

rsvp_candlelight.description: Charming candlelit dinner table close up for the RSVP section

layout_and_spacing.public_site: Asymmetrical grids, generous vertical spacing (py-24, py-32). Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile. Use max bg-black/50 for hero overlay or gradient from black to transparent. Cinematic scroll storytelling. Use framer-motion for fade-in staggers.
layout_and_spacing.admin_dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy. Left sidebar (bg-ivoire border-r border-sable/30), 2-column or 3-column dense data views. 1px borders, NO soft shadows. Flat brutalist clarity, editorial warmth.

components_strategy.public_site: Pure HTML/Tailwind containers for sections to allow full creative freedom. DO NOT use Shadcn basic Cards for the editorial public site.
components_strategy.admin_dashboard: Heavily rely on Shadcn UI (Tables, Tabs, Dialogs, Selects, Inputs) customized with our tailwind config. Make inputs flat with 1px border-sable.
components_strategy.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react with weight='thin' or weight='light' to match the elegant serif typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement two layout routes: A dark-themed layout for the public site (bg-noir text-ivoire) and a light-themed layout for the back-office (bg-ivoire text-noir).
Configure Tailwind with the exact hex colors provided in tailwind_config_extension.
Import both Cormorant Garamond and Switzer fonts in index.css.

In the public site, build the RSVP VIP digital form with customized Shadcn Form components that use a dark theme (inputs with bg-transparent border-b border-sable text-ivoire placeholder:text-sable/50).
For the admin dashboard, implement CRUD tables for Positions/People/Assignments using standard HTML table or Shadcn Table, ensuring high density and readability.
CRITICAL: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, forms) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format based on their role.
Only use the gold/copper accent (#A98A5A) for very specific highlights like CTA buttons or signature wax seals (about 5% usage).
